the problem of learning to observe, which is a fundamental problem in active learning and reinforcement learning.

The main takeaway from our work is that

RL agents can be used to learn to use the data acquisition system more efficiently and that this can lead to better sample complexity in terms of the number of samples needed to achieve satisfactory performance.
RL can be a powerful tool for designing active data acquisition schemes that can adapt to the environment and task.
RL can learn to use the observations in a more intelligent way than what a human would design, and that it can do so in a way that is robust to the state of the system.
